chapter: England, Paris and memories of Kansas City and Harlem
title: Originality in Kansas City and the Cherry Blossom jam sessions
summary: Kansas City musicians all had individual styles. The Cherry Blossom was a place for after-show jamming.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Like we had one pianist - I think I mentioned that to you once before - his name was Sleepy. His eyes were half closed and he played exactly like Art Tatum in all the difficult keys like F sharp, B natural, A natural. What was great as far as the scene of Kansas City was, that all these various styles and everybody was so original.
Was this true of all the musicians or are you speaking primarily -
Practically all the musicians. No one ever copied anybody else. That was really unique, you know, as far as Kansas City. We had the Cherry Blossom where we used to go and jam.
